method: At the finest level, freeze own previous-pass depth maps across all views. Reject a warped source sample if its projected depth lies more than 0.5% behind a valid source surface; missing source priors remain accepted. Distinct-mode margin remains .02 for both controls.
input_rules: Same own photo-derived masks and recovered cameras; scanner only posthoc evaluation. No supplied geometry/poses/depths enter stereo.

drill.render_review: Three identical recovered camera views inspected; some cleaner surfaces, extensive pits and false relief persist. Not an accepted drill reconstruction.
drill.alignment_limits: Separate posthoc similarity fits, 60000 samples with held-out scoring half, seed215,24starts; near-symmetric proper/reflected fits ambiguous, not proof of handedness, physical scale or camera accuracy.

validation_limits: No six-object adoption gate or browser execution for visibility. Native private prototype only.
Modest shape score gain does not establish accurate local detail.

bunny.render_review: Head and overview inspected in same recovered views. Eyes/nose still weak. Small strict-region F1 gain accompanies worse symmetric mean error and lower wider-region F1.

decision: Retain private control; no production integration or default change. Drill modestly improves but remains unacceptable; Bunny local accuracy is mixed. Five other objects and browser have not been evaluated.
